privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must update both a Contact and a Lead record. Required values: First Name: 'GDPR', Last Name: 'Anonymized', Email: 'gdpr@anonymized.local', Phone: '0000000000'. For the Contact only, the Mailing Address must be cleared and the exact comment 'GDPR Right to be Forgotten executed.' must be added. Both records must have 'Email Opt Out' and 'Do Not Call' enabled. Records must NOT be deleted.
